description: ol-style-name-case (issue #854): a Turtle & Rendering primitive callee written non-lowercase is flagged exactly as a Core one is. `spec/tooling.md:244` registers the rule as "built-ins should be shown lowercase" and `spec/style-guide.md` as "warns when canonical keywords or primitive names are written with other casing" — neither says "Core primitives only". This was the widest-impact silence the lint had: `PRINT` was flagged while `FORWARD`, the first command a learner ever types, was not, because the rule matched a hand-written Core-only name set instead of consulting the shared primitive registry.
